## Title Checklist

- [ ] PR title has no Conventional Commit prefix such as `feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `chore:`, or `test:`
- [ ] PR title has no internal phase name

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm lint`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm run build`

If a check is skipped, explain why:

-

## Privacy Impact

- [ ] No prompt/body/header/API key/cookie/file content is collected
- [ ] No clipboard content, exact IP address, account email, machine name, or local username is collected
- [ ] New or changed data fields are documented
- [ ] Manual reports, official status, and installed signals remain separate in storage and API contracts
- [ ] Any unified UI summary keeps source breakdown visible
